description: Takes two voltages and puts the larger of them out of one jack and the smaller out of the other

params.text: Takes a fresh pair of readings, as a rising edge at the trigger jack does
Adds -5V to 5V to the first voltage before it is multiplied by the scale knob beneath it
Multiplies the first voltage after its offset knob has been added, -5 to 5
Adds -5V to 5V to the second voltage before it is multiplied by the scale knob beneath it
Multiplies the second voltage after its offset knob has been added, -5 to 5

inputs.text: A rising edge here takes a fresh pair of readings and updates both outputs
One of the two voltages compared, taken before the offset and scale knobs beneath it are applied
The other voltage compared, taken before the offset and scale knobs beneath it are applied

outputs.text: Carries whichever of the two voltages is the larger
Carries whichever of the two voltages is the smaller

notes: in the module's default Hold mode the outputs only move when the trigger jack rises or the button is pressed
menu: Track — keeps both outputs following the inputs continuously, but only while nothing is patched to the trigger jack
Hold — updates the outputs only on a trigger or a button press, and is the setting the module comes up in

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
